{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module AuthProxy where

import Data.Word (Word64, Word32)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftL, shiftR, (.&.))
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX (getPOSIXTime)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.ByteString.Builder (word64HexFixed, toLazyByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Monad (forever, void)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- | Internal PRNG state using xoshiro256** algorithm
data PrngState = PrngState
  { s0 :: !Word64
  , s1 :: !Word64
  , s2 :: !Word64
  , s3 :: !Word64
  } deriving (Show)

globalPrng :: IORef PrngState
globalPrng = unsafePerformIO $ do
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let seed = floor (t * 1000000) :: Word64
  -- Initialize with splitmix64 from seed
  let z0 = seed + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15
      z1 = (z0 `xor` (z0 `shiftR` 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9
      z2 = (z1 `xor` (z1 `shiftR` 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111eb
      z3 = z2 `xor` (z2 `shiftR` 31)
  newIORef (PrngState z0 z1 z2 z3)
{-# NOINLINE globalPrng #-}

-- | Rotate left operation
rotl :: Word64 -> Int -> Word64
rotl x k = (x `shiftL` k) `xor` (x `shiftR` (64 - k))

-- | Generate next random Word64 using xoshiro256** 
nextRandom :: IORef PrngState -> IO Word64
nextRandom ref = do
  st <- readIORef ref
  let result = rotl (s1 st * 5) 7 * 9
      t = s1 st `shiftL` 17
      s2' = s2 st `xor` s0 st
      s3' = s3 st `xor` s1 st
      s1' = s1 st `xor` s2'
      s0' = s0 st `xor` s3'
      s2'' = s2' `xor` t
      s3'' = rotl s3' 45
  writeIORef ref (PrngState s0' s1' s2'' s3'')
  return result

-- | Token entropy pool - collects system entropy periodically
data EntropyPool = EntropyPool
  { poolState   :: IORef PrngState
  , poolCounter :: IORef Word64
  , poolMixer   :: IORef Word64
  }

initEntropyPool :: IO EntropyPool
initEntropyPool = do
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let seed = floor (t * 1000000) :: Word64
  st <- newIORef (PrngState seed (seed `xor` 0xdeadbeef) (seed + 42) (seed * 7))
  ctr <- newIORef 0
  mixer <- newIORef seed
  return (EntropyPool st ctr mixer)

-- | Mix additional entropy into the pool
reseedPool :: EntropyPool -> IO ()
reseedPool pool = do
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let timeBits = floor (t * 1000) :: Word64
  modifyIORef' (poolMixer pool) (`xor` timeBits)
  ctr <- readIORef (poolCounter pool)
  modifyIORef' (poolCounter pool) (+1)
  -- Mix counter with time for additional entropy
  let mixed = timeBits `xor` (ctr * 0x517cc1b727220a95)
  modifyIORef' (poolState pool) (\s -> s { s0 = s0 s `xor` mixed })

-- | Generate a 128-bit authentication token
-- Uses pool state mixed with counter for uniqueness
generateAuthToken :: EntropyPool -> IO BS.ByteString
generateAuthToken pool = do
  reseedPool pool
  -- Generate two 64-bit values for 128-bit token
  hi <- nextRandom (poolState pool)
  lo <- nextRandom (poolState pool)
  mixer <- readIORef (poolMixer pool)
  ctr <- readIORef (poolCounter pool)
  -- Final mixing step: XOR with mixer state
  -- Note: mixer is derived from millisecond-precision time
  let tokenHi = hi `xor` mixer
      tokenLo = lo `xor` (mixer `rotl` 32)
  let hiBS = BL.toStrict $ toLazyByteString $ word64HexFixed tokenHi
      loBS = BL.toStrict $ toLazyByteString $ word64HexFixed tokenLo
  return $ hiBS <> loBS

-- | Validate token format (32 hex chars = 128 bits)
validateTokenFormat :: BS.ByteString -> Bool
validateTokenFormat tok = BS.length tok == 32 && BS.all isHexChar tok
  where isHexChar w = (w >= 0x30 && w <= 0x39) || (w >= 0x61 && w <= 0x66)

-- | Active token store for cross-service auth
type TokenStore = IORef [(BS.ByteString, Word64)]  -- (token, expiry)

newTokenStore :: IO TokenStore
newTokenStore = newIORef []

issueToken :: EntropyPool -> TokenStore -> IO BS.ByteString
issueToken pool store = do
  tok <- generateAuthToken pool
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let expiry = floor t + 300  -- 5 minute expiry
  modifyIORef' store ((tok, expiry) :)
  return tok

verifyToken :: TokenStore -> BS.ByteString -> IO Bool
verifyToken store tok = do
  t <- getPOSIXTime
  let now = floor t
  tokens <- readIORef store
  let valid = any (\(t', exp') -> t' == tok && exp' > now) tokens
  -- Cleanup expired
  writeIORef store (filter (\(_, exp') -> exp' > now) tokens)
  return valid

-- | Proxy handler - authenticates upstream requests
handleClient :: EntropyPool -> TokenStore -> Socket -> IO ()
handleClient pool store clientSock = do
  req <- recv clientSock 4096
  case parseRequest req of
    Just ("AUTH", _) -> do
      tok <- issueToken pool store
      sendAll clientSock ("TOKEN:" <> tok <> "\n")
    Just ("PROXY", payload) -> do
      let (tokPart, rest) = BS.splitAt 32 payload
      valid <- verifyToken store tokPart
      if valid
        then do
          -- Forward to upstream service
          sendAll clientSock ("OK:" <> rest <> "\n")
        else sendAll clientSock "ERR:INVALID_TOKEN\n"
    _ -> sendAll clientSock "ERR:BAD_REQUEST\n"
  close clientSock

parseRequest :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe (BS.ByteString, BS.ByteString)
parseRequest bs = case BC.split ':' bs of
  (cmd:rest) -> Just (cmd, BS.intercalate ":" rest)
  _ -> Nothing

-- | Start the proxy server
startProxy :: Int -> IO ()
startProxy port = do
  pool <- initEntropyPool
  store <- newTokenStore
  -- Background entropy collection thread
  void $ forkIO $ forever $ do
    threadDelay 100000  -- 100ms
    reseedPool pool
  sock <- socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol
  setSocketOption sock ReuseAddr 1
  bind sock (SockAddrInet (fromIntegral port) 0)
  listen sock 128
  forever $ do
    (clientSock, _) <- accept sock
    void $ forkIO $ handleClient pool store clientSock
